items.a: Yes. Luv Fats ice cream is dairy-free and egg-free, made on a base of coconut milk and avocado.
Chi wanted a dairy-free scoop that wasn’t icy and didn’t just taste like the milk it was made from. Coconut milk, avocado, a little cocoa butter and avocado oil give it that dense, creamy texture.
Not really. The avocado is there for texture and richness; the flavor comes from what Chi pairs it with: chai, lavender, fruit, herbs.
The case rotates, so check Instagram before you come. The Flavors page is a library of past and recurring flavors, not today’s menu.
Wednesday to Sunday, 1 to 8 pm. Closed Monday and Tuesday. Holiday changes are posted on Instagram first.
4700 Loyola Lane, Suite 101, Austin, TX 78723, in Northeast Austin. The old North Lamar window has closed.
Some flavors and toppings may contain nuts, gluten or soy, and everything is made in one small kitchen. If you have an allergy, ask at the counter before you order.
A torched marshmallow fluff, made vegan with aquafaba. It’s the topping most people come back for.
Yes, pints are sold at the shop. You can also send a pint request from the Pints page and the team will confirm availability and pickup.

items.q: Do you sell to cafés or stores?
items.a: Luv Fats is growing its wholesale side. Send a request from the Wholesale page with your business and volume.

items.q: Can Luv Fats come to my event?
items.a: Send an event request with the date, headcount and location. Every request gets a reply, but not every date is possible.

items.q: Do you take returns on pints?
items.a: Please bring your clean pint container back to reuse. Fewer containers is part of how Luv Fats keeps waste down.
